title: DON'T GO HOME
logline: Maya receives a voicemail from her own voice twenty-four hours in the future warning her not to go home, then discovers a chilling message on her boyfriend's phone.

characters.Maya: 25, financial analyst. Dark hair, white blouse, black coat. Sharp, guarded, increasingly afraid.
characters.Ethan: 29, cybersecurity engineer. Dark coat, calm voice, unreadable expression.
characters.Future Maya: Maya's own voice, sounding exhausted and terrified.

scenes.phone_body: Maya, listen to me. Do not go home before eleven.
scenes.speaker: Future Maya
scenes.tts: Maya, listen to me. Do not go home before eleven.
scenes.subtitle: Do not go home before eleven.

scenes.phone_body: And the man waiting outside your apartment... he is not there to protect you.
scenes.speaker: Future Maya
scenes.tts: And the man waiting outside your apartment... he is not there to protect you.
scenes.subtitle: The man outside your apartment is not there to protect you.

scenes.speaker: Ethan
scenes.tts: There you are. I've been calling you.
scenes.subtitle: There you are. I've been calling you.

scenes.phone_body: Do not let him see your phone.
scenes.speaker: Future Maya
scenes.tts: Do not let him see your phone.
scenes.subtitle: Do not let him see your phone.

scenes.speaker: Ethan
scenes.tts: Maya? What's wrong? You look terrified.
scenes.subtitle: Maya? What's wrong? You look terrified.

scenes.speaker: Maya
scenes.tts: Nothing. The elevator just stopped for a second.
scenes.subtitle: Nothing. The elevator just stopped for a second.

scenes.speaker: Ethan
scenes.tts: Your phone keeps buzzing. Who is texting you?
scenes.subtitle: Your phone keeps buzzing. Who is texting you?

scenes.message:
She heard the recording.
Continue as planned.

scenes.speaker: Ethan
scenes.tts: You weren't supposed to hear that yet.
scenes.subtitle: You weren't supposed to hear that yet.
